## Description

Please include a summary of the change, the rationale behind it, and which sections of `SKILL.md` or `samples/comparison.md` are affected.

Fixes # (issue link, if applicable)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an agent translation failure)
- [ ] New style directive/rule (adds a new plain English guideline)
- [ ] Rule refinement (polishes or clarifies an existing guideline)
- [ ] Example addition (adds new before/after samples)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) document.
- [ ] My rule changes have been added to [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).
- [ ] I have provided corresponding before-and-after examples in [samples/comparison.md](samples/comparison.md).
- [ ] I have verified that the new language preserves essential legal mechanisms and terms of art.
- [ ] The text is gender-neutral and follows modern professional drafting standards.
